label: TiO2Pnma
note: Hypothetical Pnma-type TiO2 polymorph, never synthesized -- added from Reitz & Dronskowski (Inorg. Chem. 2026, revised/reviewer-added case, Figure 8/eq. 9): r2SCAN E_above_hull=10.42 kJ/mol, DeltaE(r2SCAN, vs rutile)=-8 kJ/mol, DeltaICOHP=-9 kJ/mol, exobondic. CORRECTION: this note previously claimed the compound was 'computed here with this project's own PBEsol/D3 settings' -- that was WRONG. This project's extension_ pipeline (prepare_vasp_lobster.py INCAR_SETTINGS) runs plain PBE with no dispersion correction (confirmed via OUTCAR: GGA=--, no IVDW line), not PBEsol+D3, so this entry is neither a literal reproduction of the manuscript's r2SCAN number nor computed at their PBEsol+D3 level. See extension_TiO2rutile_mp-2657 (added alongside, same plain-PBE pipeline settings) for the matching decomposition-product reference under this project's actual level of theory; DeltaICOHP(Pnma->rutile) recomputed this way = -10.05 kJ/mol, in good agreement with the manuscript's -9 kJ/mol despite the different functional (r2SCAN vs plain PBE here).
